# Project

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Project a lat/lng point to a screen position. Requires the ViewState and dimensions of the map.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/project",
  "type": "ProjectOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/project').par.position` (an input) and `op('/project').out.screenPosition` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.position`, `out.screenPosition`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `position` | `Point2DField` | `{"lng":0,"lat":0}` |
| `width` | `NumberField` | `1920` |
| `height` | `NumberField` | `1080` |
| `viewState` | `CompoundPropsField` | `{"latitude":40.7128,"longitude":-74.006,"zoom":12,"pitch":0,"bearing":0}` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `screenPosition` | `Vec2Field` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
